$comment: THE source of truth for the PRESS brand. Every color, stack and identity default in every artifact Nate produces is generated from this file. Do not hand-copy these values into a consumer — declare the consumer in targets.json and run `press emit` instead. See laws.md for what the values MEAN and why there are so few of them.
name: press

terminal.$comment: The dark panel is the ONE place the old dark palette survives, and only inside a .term element. This quartet never appears on paper.

color_notes.paper: Warm cream. Flat — never gradiented, never textured.
color_notes.paper_surface: One step down from paper, for a panel that must separate from the page without a border. Still flat.
color_notes.paper_elevated: Two steps down. The deepest paper tone; below this, use an ink rule instead.
color_notes.ink: Near-black. Text, headlines, and every structural rule.
color_notes.dim: Muted secondary text; the serif commentary voice's color.
color_notes.accent: THE one loud color. Spent once or twice per document, never as decoration.
color_notes.rule: Rules are ink, named separately so an override can soften them without touching text color.
color_notes.ink_mid: Mid ink step: a second series, a stacked-bar segment, a bar track.
color_notes.ink_faint: Decorative only — a faint element inside an illustration. Never body text, never a headline.

derived.$comment: Alpha tints, all computed from ink or accent so no consumer writes an rgba() by hand. hair (0.18) and border (0.16) are the SAME IDEA at two different strengths — the résumé's hairline and the site's. That is a real inconsistency, kept deliberately: reconciling them would change one of two shipped products, which is a decision to make on purpose and not as a side effect of adopting press.

fonts.$comment: The union of every consumer's stack. Fallbacks are additive, so the richest chain is the canonical one — the résumé's print-tuned stacks were the deepest and became these. Single quotes so the same string is valid CSS and needs no escaping in a Python literal.
fonts.display_stack: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
fonts.serif_stack: 'New York', ui-serif, Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif
fonts.mono_stack: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Code', 'JetBrains Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
